boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named ECU spaces for studying, recording, tutoring, gathering, gaming, and taking a quieter break between classes.

cards.title: Use the Student Center’s Central Commons
cards.subtitle: A 10,000-square-foot gathering and study area
cards.notes: Meet classmates in the central commons, then use the surrounding lounges or study rooms when your group needs a different setup.
cards.short_summary: A flexible rendezvous point inside the Main Campus Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU identifies the 10,000-square-foot GUC Commons as the Main Campus Student Center’s central artery and gathering spot and documents lounges for study and relaxation.
cards.source_title: Main Campus Student Center | Student Centers | ECU
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Main Campus Student Center at 501 East 10th Street; consult the linked ECU page and current center hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Main Campus Student Center Game Room
cards.title: Reset Between Classes in the Game Room
cards.subtitle: Indoor recreation without leaving the student center
cards.notes: Bring classmates for a short recreation break, and check the center directory or welcome desk for current room procedures.
cards.short_summary: A named student-center space for casual games and downtime.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU lists the Game Room among the Main Campus Student Center’s programs and services and says its gaming room and pool tables support recreation and social interaction.
cards.source_title: Main Campus Student Center | Student Centers | ECU
cards.access_notes: Inside the Main Campus Student Center; building access and Game Room procedures may vary, so verify them with Student Centers before going.

cards.entity_name: Ledonia Wright Cultural Center Lending Library
cards.title: Browse the Cultural Center’s Lending Library
cards.subtitle: Books and resources inside the Main Campus Student Center
cards.notes: Stop in to explore the culturally focused collection, then ask center staff about borrowing rules or related campus programming.
cards.short_summary: A focused collection within a broader cultural gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU states that the Ledonia Wright Cultural Center Lending Library provides culturally enriching books and resources inside the Main Campus Student Center.
cards.source_title: Main Campus Student Center | Student Centers | ECU
cards.access_notes: Located within the Ledonia Wright Cultural Center in the Main Campus Student Center; ask staff about current borrowing and visitor access.

cards.title: Book a Lower-Stimulation Study Room
cards.subtitle: Adjustable study spaces for groups of two to six
cards.notes: Reserve one when soothing lighting, ergonomic seating, and a calmer setting would help your group focus on a demanding task.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms designed around a calmer study environment.
cards.evidence_claim: Joyner Library’s reservation system describes Alternative Study Rooms for two to six people with soothing lighting, ergonomic seating, and a focus-supporting ambiance.
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required through Joyner Library’s booking page; current availability and booking limits appear in the reservation system.

cards.title: Study While Caring for Children
cards.subtitle: A reservable room designed for families
cards.notes: Reserve this room when coursework and caregiving overlap; it gives children and parents a dedicated place to spend study time together.
cards.short_summary: A practical study option for students balancing family responsibilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Joyner Library describes its Family Room as a space designed for children and parents to study together, with capacity for two to six people.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through Joyner Library’s booking system and review the current availability and room-use terms before arrival.

cards.title: Record a Presentation With One Button
cards.subtitle: Joyner Library room 1035 for groups of one to six
cards.notes: Reserve the studio for a class video or rehearsal, then follow WayFinder from the entrance to room 1035 on the first floor.
cards.short_summary: A reservable recording setup intended to simplify video production.
cards.evidence_claim: Joyner Library says its Video Recording Center supports high-quality, one-button video recording for one to six people; WayFinder locates it in room 1035.
cards.access_notes: Advance reservation is available through Joyner Library; the room is on the first floor in room 1035, subject to library access and hours.

cards.title: Study Alongside Rotating Art Displays
cards.subtitle: A 3,700-square-foot gallery and study space in Joyner Library
cards.notes: Use the gallery for seated work while exhibitions permit, and check library notices before relying on it during installations or events.
cards.short_summary: Joyner Library combines an exhibition venue with student study space.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU’s University Archives describes the Janice Hardison Faulkner Gallery as a renovated gallery and study space that showcases art by ECU faculty and students.
cards.source_title: Janice Hardison Faulkner Papers - ECU Collection Guides
cards.access_notes: Located in Joyner Library; gallery availability may change for exhibitions and events, so consult library information before visiting.

cards.title: Work With Scores Near Listening Resources
cards.subtitle: A specialized library in the A.J. Fletcher Music Center
cards.notes: Bring score-heavy coursework here for study space and music resources, then ask library staff about listening or viewing equipment.
cards.short_summary: A subject library where music materials and study space share one setting.
cards.evidence_claim: An ECU Libraries fact sheet says the Music Library provides a computer and listening lab, study space, audiovisual services, and music reference assistance.
cards.access_notes: Located in the A.J. Fletcher Music Center; check the current Music Library hours page because opening times change by date and term.

cards.title: Turn a Study Session Into a Tutoring Appointment
cards.subtitle: Suite 2300 in the Old Cafeteria Complex
cards.notes: Book tutoring, a study group, or academic coaching online, and bring the course materials or study challenge you want to address.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated place to add peer or professional support to coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU states that the Pirate Academic Success Center offers free tutoring, study groups, academic-skills coaching, and peer coaching to enrolled ECU students.
cards.access_notes: For enrolled ECU students; the center is in suite 2300 on the Old Cafeteria Complex’s second floor, and appointments can be booked online.

cards.entity_name: Richard R. and JoAnn M. Eakin Student Recreation Center
cards.title: Switch From Coursework to Movement
cards.subtitle: Pools, courts, track, climbing wall, and fitness zones
cards.notes: Choose a short swim, track session, or workout between classes, and confirm eligibility plus area-specific hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A multi-activity recreation facility close to ECU’s academic core.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU documents that the Eakin Student Recreation Center contains basketball courts, pools, an indoor track, a 27-foot climbing wall, fitness zones, and studios.
cards.source_title: Eakin Student Recreation Center | Campus Recreation & Wellness | ECU
cards.access_notes: Entry eligibility, guest access, rentals, and individual facility hours vary; verify them on the official Campus Recreation page before visiting.
